assets.title: Bold beveled focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four broad chamfered corner shapes with small gray tabs around an empty rectangular center.
assets.animation: Visible from frame zero; corners move inward and rotate into alignment, hold still, then rotate and shrink away.

assets.title: Triple stepped focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four corners each contain three nested angular line brackets with chamfered elbows.
assets.animation: Already visible at start; nested lines settle inward, hold, then shorten and fade in staggered order.

assets.title: Cut corner focus brackets with separated tips on black
assets.visual: Four chamfered line corners with detached end strokes and a short inner gray detail.
assets.animation: Visible corners and detached tips settle into a tighter frame, hold, then retract in parts and fade.

assets.title: Dotted focus corner brackets with square beads on black
assets.visual: Four solid elbows with rows of five tapering square beads along each arm.
assets.animation: Beads are present at start and settle toward the elbows; static hold followed by staggered bead retraction and fade.

assets.title: Folded fan focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four corners made from horizontal and vertical tapered leaves and a small triangular center fold.
assets.animation: Visible leaves rotate around corner pins into alignment, hold, then fold outward and fade.

assets.title: Hand drawn style ink focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four individually shaped rounded ink corners with fine echo strokes on two corners.
assets.animation: Strokes start complete and move inward to lock; steady hold, then strokes erase along their paths. Drawing entrance is disabled by default.

assets.title: Interlocking tab focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four stepped horizontal and vertical tab corners separated by small seams and accented with gray latch details.
assets.animation: Visible tab pieces slide together and lock, hold, then separate and fade with the latch releasing first.

assets.title: Double offset focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four corners pairing a thick ivory right angle with a thin offset gray right angle.
assets.animation: Visible line pairs approach and tighten their spacing, hold still, then shorten and fade at different speeds.

assets.title: Pivoting focus corner brackets with circular nodes on black
assets.visual: Four circular corner nodes with separate perpendicular arms ending in short crossbars and gray ticks.
assets.animation: Already visible arms pivot toward right angles while corners move inward; hold, then arms pivot away and retract.

assets.title: Pixel block focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four corners composed of separated rectangular tiles with small inset gray squares.
assets.animation: Visible blocks settle into corner alignment, hold, then disperse outward and fade in staggered order.

assets.title: Precision line focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four clean right angle line corners accompanied by shorter thin gray parallel rail strokes.
assets.animation: Corners begin visible, move inward to lock, hold, then shorten and retract with secondary rails disappearing first.

assets.title: Curled ribbon focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four corners made of curved tapering horizontal ivory and vertical gray ribbon shapes with small inner arcs.
assets.animation: Visible ribbon arms uncurl and align as corners close inward, hold, then rotate and collapse away.

assets.title: Rounded focus corner brackets with soft snap on black
assets.visual: Four simple thick ivory line corners with rounded bends and endpoints; secondaryColor is unused in visible geometry.
assets.animation: Visible corners close inward with one small compression pulse, hold still, then shorten and fade.

assets.title: Triple arc focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four groups of three concentric quarter circle arcs with a thick ivory middle arc and thin gray outer arcs.
assets.animation: Complete arcs rotate into place and close inward, hold, then rotate away and shorten in staggered order.

assets.title: Woven ribbon focus corner brackets on black
assets.visual: Four corners resembling crossing flat ivory and gray ribbons with angled ends and small inner line accents.
assets.animation: Visible strips slide into their woven alignment, hold still, then slide apart and shorten.

assets.title: Blank capsule caption strip with blue gray accents on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory capsule panel at lower third with blue gray end arcs, a fine track below and a central indicator.
assets.animation: Starts empty; rounded body expands horizontally, arcs draw and indicator arrives, stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold, staged retraction ending by 9.8 seconds.

assets.title: Blank enamel caption strip with green buckles on black
assets.visual: Empty cream rounded panel with layered green enamel border, two metallic green side buckles, rim highlights and inset outline.
assets.animation: Base and enamel reveal from center, side buckles slide inward, line details draw, stationary hold from 1.35-8.6 seconds, then staged exit.

assets.title: Blank folded ticket caption strip on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory ticket shape with clipped corners, muted terracotta left tab and folded upper right corner with gray fold shadow.
assets.animation: Left tab opens, panel reveals left to right and corner flap unfolds; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then staged retraction.

assets.title: Blank beveled prism caption strip in pale blue on black
assets.visual: Empty pale blue gray panel with clipped faceted corners, blue gradient bevel, slate backing and bright edge reflections.
assets.animation: Backing and bevel slide into alignment, center panel reveals horizontally and reflection lines draw; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then layered release.

assets.title: Blank layered caption strip with sage sleeve on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory panel offset over a sage backing sheet, with clipped corners and a gray binding folded around the right edge.
assets.animation: Backing extends rightward, front panel slides in from left and right binding folds over; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then reverse release.

assets.title: Blank open outline caption frame with gold accents on black
assets.visual: Empty rectangular ivory outline with deliberate gaps, a gold upper right corner and gold side tick; center shows the same black background, with no filled panel.
assets.animation: Outline paths draw in staggered sections, hold still from 1.35-8.6 seconds, then retract.

assets.title: Blank origami caption strip with folded wings on black
assets.visual: Empty cream paper panel with clipped corners, blue gray and terracotta folded side wings and shaded top and bottom folds.
assets.animation: Side wings unfold with staggered skew and scale, center panel expands, fold details arrive; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then staged folding exit.

assets.title: Blank ribbon caption banner with folded tails on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory rectangular ribbon panel with tan notched tails, gray fold shadows and small edge details.
assets.animation: Tails rotate open, center panel expands and folds assemble; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then staged folding exit.

assets.title: Blank caption strip with hinged sage side clamps on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory panel with gray inset edges and two rounded sage side clamps with small ivory hinge dots.
assets.animation: Clamps arrive and pivot inward around hinges as panel expands from center; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then grip release and retraction.

assets.title: Blank sliding caption strip with blue spine on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory panel with blue gray vertical spine on the left, guide line below and a triangular upper right tab.
assets.animation: Spine extends vertically and panel slides right from behind it; guide and corner tab arrive; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then drawer retracts.

assets.title: Blank split caption strip with gold end accents on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory panel formed from two joined halves with gold vertical end stripes and paired gray bridge bars above and below the center.
assets.animation: Halves expand left and right from center, end stripes and bridge bars assemble; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then staggered collapse.

assets.title: Blank caption strip assembled from three slats on black
assets.visual: Three stacked ivory horizontal slats join into one empty rectangular panel with alternating blue gray edge strips and a short locking bar.
assets.animation: Slats enter from left, right and below; lock and underline details arrive; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then slats release separately.

assets.title: Blank stepped edge caption strip with lilac accents on black
assets.visual: Empty ivory rectangular strip with a two step protruding right end, lilac stepped border and left vertical accent.
assets.animation: Left rail appears, panel grows horizontally and right steps extend in sequence; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then staged retraction.

assets.title: Blank torn paper collage caption strip with tape on black
assets.visual: Empty cream torn paper panel over an offset lavender sheet, fine edge fibers and two muted terracotta tape patches.
assets.animation: Backing slides into place, ragged moving edge reveals front paper, tape patches descend and rotate; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then staged exit.

assets.title: Blank woven border caption strip with stitching on black
assets.visual: Empty cream panel in a sage border with crossing terracotta and dark teal side ribbons, center diamonds and short cream stitching along top and bottom.
assets.animation: Border and panel expand, side ribbons slide diagonally into crossed positions, locking diamonds and stitches appear; stationary 1.35-8.6 second hold then staged release.

assets.title: Five animated directional arrows in ivory on black
assets.visual: Five sequential arrows: thin straight precision, bold cut, hand drawn sweep, segmented chevron flow and curved guide; ivory with blue gray details.
assets.animation: Five six-second slots; first arrow starts complete, later designs draw or assemble by 0.7 seconds, two directional nudges during hold, exit at 5-5.7 seconds, black gap to next slot.

assets.title: Five folded and curved directional arrow designs on black
assets.visual: Five sequential designs: folded ribbon, rounded elbow, leftward hook return, converging lanes and chisel brush arrow; ivory with blue gray details.
assets.animation: Five six-second slots; first ribbon starts visible, later designs trace or wipe on, two bounded directional nudges during holds, erase or retract at 5-5.7 seconds, black gap.

assets.title: Five radial impact accents with shards and star on black
assets.visual: Five sequential impact designs: tapered radial rays, faceted shards, ink flicks with droplets, four point prism star and expanding hexagonal rings.
assets.animation: Five six-second slots, three isolated hits per slot at 0, 1.9 and 3.8 seconds. Hits grow or radiate quickly and decay within 1.55 seconds; first hit starts formed. Fifteen hits total, five designs.

assets.title: Five comic impact accents with crescents and blocks on black
assets.visual: Five sequential designs: jagged hollow comic burst, three crescent whips, stepped block shards, angular folded ribbons and four corner claps with small diamonds.
assets.animation: Five six-second slots, three isolated hits per slot at 0, 1.9 and 3.8 seconds. Quick attack, outward expansion or rotation and rapid decay within 1.55 seconds; first hit starts formed. Fifteen hits total.

assets.title: Five blank painted brush caption strips on black
assets.visual: Five empty painted strips: dry bristle cream, thick terracotta paint, blue double swipe, yellow ink ribbon and sage arc sweep with underline. Centers stay solid for buyer-added text.
assets.animation: Sequential slots at 0, 7, 14, 22 and 29 seconds; bristle-shaped masks paint in from alternating directions, hold still, then wipe away; first frame empty.

assets.title: Five blank natural bristle brush caption strips on black
assets.visual: Five empty organic paint strips: ivory bristles, clay gouache, dry blue, sage over ivory underpainting and ochre arc. Fine irregular filaments and pigment flecks stay near edges around a solid text area.
assets.animation: Sequential slots at 0, 8, 16, 24 and 33 seconds; independently timed filaments reveal strokes, hold still then wipe away; sage overpaint uses two paint passes; first frame empty.

assets.title: Five animated circle and oval highlight markers on black
assets.visual: Five empty-centered highlights: ivory pencil orbit, ochre dry brush loop, terracotta double sweep, sage segmented ring and cream ink oval with flourish.
assets.animation: Five seven-second slots; paths trace and masked bands draw in, hold still, erase along contour around 5.7-6.7 seconds and leave a black gap; first frame empty.

assets.title: Five expressive circle and oval highlight markers on black
assets.visual: Five empty-centered markers: cream felt band, sage hatched oval, blue multi-turn orbit, ochre folded ribbon ring and terracotta sketch oval with short emphasis rays.
assets.animation: Five seven-second slots; lines, hatching and masked bands draw progressively, hold still, erase to black around 5.7-6.7 seconds; first frame empty.

assets.title: Five animated attention marks with strokes and arches on black
assets.visual: Five accents around an invisible subject point: ivory pencil triplet, ochre opposing brush braces, terracotta fan strokes, blue folded tabs and sage ink arches. No exclamation symbol in this pack.
assets.animation: Five seven-second slots; strokes trace, braces reveal by masks, fans extend and tabs scale with stagger; hold still then erase or collapse to black, first frame empty.

assets.title: Five attention accents with lightning and exclamations on black
assets.visual: Five accents above an invisible subject point: gold split lightning, blue ribbon curls, terracotta exclamations, sage petal crown and cream cross hatch sparks with small diamonds.
assets.animation: Five seven-second slots; bolts, exclamations and petals extend or scale, curls and crosses trace with stagger; stationary holds then retract or erase to black; first frame empty.
